te: Urgent meeting: framework for a holistic study on resolving the unrest in the southern border provinces, and follow-up on the subcommittees' work
se: Meeting (called as an urgent matter) on Tuesday 24 November 2026 at 14.30, Meeting Room 301, floor 3 (Senate side), Parliament House, according to the meeting notice. The main item is the framework for studying how to resolve the unrest in the southern border provinces, so as to raise the quality of development in every dimension holistically. The meeting also follows up on the work of the subcommittees, the report on the study visit to Songkhla and Pattani (30–31 Oct 2026), the draft report on the committee's work for fiscal year 2026, and the appointment of additional honorary advisers for fiscal year 2027
it: Framework for studying how to resolve the unrest in the southern border provinces, to raise the quality of development in every dimension holistically

te: Hearing from the Thep Satri Task Force and the Chanthaburi and Trat Border Defence Command on boundaries and security along the border

it: Problems and solutions concerning boundaries and the security situation along the border

te: Following up the subcommittees, and considering a complaint about the halal food certification system
se: Meeting on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 14.00, Committee Meeting Room CA 330, Floor 3, Parliament House, according to the meeting notice: the agenda is the progress of the subcommittees and working groups, and a complaint asking for a review of Thailand's halal food certification system and for an alternative certification system under state oversight, considering the scope of authority under the Islamic Organization Administration Act B.E. 2540, the Agricultural Standards Act B.E. 2551 and the Trademark Act B.E. 2534. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
it: Progress of the subcommittees and working groups

Complaint: a request to review Thailand's halal food certification system and to develop an alternative certification system under state oversight (considering the scope of authority under the relevant laws)
